# Lucy

## Overview

- **Age:** Seventeen years old  <sub>[v1 c5 P11](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0011), [v4 c31 P4](../source/v04-c31.md#nw-v04-c31-p0004)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c5 P14](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0014)</sub>
- **Status:** Alive  <sub>[v5 c31 P4](../source/v05-c31.md#nw-v05-c31-p0004)</sub>
- **Origin:** Marysville (raised)  <sub>[v1 c5 P14](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0014)</sub>
- **Role:** Student and helper around the household  <sub>[v2 c18 P30](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0030), [v2 c21 P1](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0001)</sub>

## Appearance

Lucy is described as a neat, starched, and genteel little girl with hazel eyes and long, sleek, dark or brown curls. She is the twin sister of Robin, though the two look very little alike, as she has a straight nose and a polite, 'prunes and prisms' expression.

_Sources: [v1 c18 P28](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0028), [v2 c8 P8](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0008), [v2 c8 P25](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0025), [v2 c8 P44](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0044)_

## Personality

Lucy is quiet, well-behaved, obedient, and very orderly. She is easily frightened, especially by cows, dark places, and stories of ghosts or dead relatives. Unlike her twin brother Robin, she is naturally tidy and well-mannered, though she can be easily influenced or bullied by him.

_Sources: [v1 c18 P21](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0021), [v1 c18 P28](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0028), [v2 c8 P8](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0008), [v2 c10 P3](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0003), [v2 c21 P2](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0002)_

## Goals

- To be well-behaved and maintain order  <sub>[v1 c18 P28](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0028), [v2 c8 P8](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0008)</sub>

## History

After the death of her mother, Mary Farrow, Lucy and her twin brother Robin were taken in by Thirza Abernethy and Nell Harcourt to live at Grey Shutters. During her first winter there, she fell ill with croup, but her life was saved by Nell's prompt care before the doctor arrived. Lucy quickly settled into farm life, tending a tidy little garden plot and helping Thirza with light household tasks and chores. In contrast to her mischievous twin, she remained consistently polite and gentle, though Robin frequently coaxed or threatened her into minor misadventures, such as walking a pigpen fence or skipping Sunday School. As she grew into a teenager, she continued to attend the local school in Brierley and began taking music lessons from Clementine Ainslie. By the age of seventeen, she had attracted her first suitor, Ralph Pullen.

_Sources: [v1 c18 P28](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0028), [v1 c18 P31](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0031), [v1 c27 P3](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0003), [v2 c8 P8](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0008), [v2 c8 P44](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0044), [v2 c13 P1](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0001), [v2 c13 P25](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0025), [v2 c23 P20](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0020), [v4 c31 P3](../source/v04-c31.md#nw-v04-c31-p0003), [v4 c31 P5](../source/v04-c31.md#nw-v04-c31-p0005)_
